'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Set Your Labia for Stun'''. Objective not written in the 60 (start Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince). L1 '''Tatooine - ep1''' → Tatooine. L27 Bhangus → Brangus Glee (V). L39 OS 72 10 → OS-72-10. L51 Ghhhk comb.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Username:''' Advocate
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
